findings.summary: Self-employed with years 1-5: empty bar and orange note, no figure, yet the year can still be selected
At year 4 the only number shown (25,725) is for the securities-account comparison and is easily mistaken for the fund amount
Input boxes swap places after switching to self-employed
Chart headings: dark background, grey text, pink tax label; hard to read and alarming
Bar colours (yellow, two greens) too close to tell apart
Unfamiliar terms under the chart (index track, S&P 500, unknown company)
